programme.title: Orphelins de la nature: Danger : braconniers
programme.desc: Malgré toutes les précautions qui ont été prises, les braconniers se rapprochent de la réserve naturelle; les conséquences sont toujours néfastes et des mesures doivent être prises rapidement. Une femelle léopard est retrouvée morte.

programme.title: Orphelins de la nature: Un lycaon en danger
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui presque adulte, les chiens sauvages sont le projet le plus précieux et la plus grande responsabilité de Marlice, Lorsqu'une personne est mordue par un serpent, ils se déplacent rapidement pour la sauver.

programme.title: Orphelins de la nature: Les guépards d'Omaru
programme.desc: Afin d'éviter les conflits au sein du groupe, deux babouins sont castrés ; deux jeunes guépards intègrent le sanctuaire.

programme.title: Orphelins de la nature: Un guépard chez le dentiste
programme.desc: C'est le jour du recensement annuel des animaux. Pour les compter, Rudie prend les airs. Une femelle guépard présente un abcès à une dent qu'il faut absolument soigner.

programme.title: Orphelins de la nature: Le grand départ
programme.desc: Marlice et Rudie se préparent à remettre en liberté sept guépards et un léopard, mais pour cela, il faut d'abord attraper les félins.

programme.title: Le Magicien Des Protheses Animales
programme.desc: Turbo Roo et Thor sont des chihuahuas turbulents à qui il manque les pattes avant. Derrick doit innover en créant des chariots personnalisés imprimés en 3D afin que les chiens puissent profiter de la vie avec leur famille aimante.

programme.title: Le Magicien Des Protheses Animales
programme.desc: Bert est un cochon atteint d'une maladie des tissus qui affecte ses quatre pattes et l'oblige à marcher sur les chevilles. Derrick n'a jamais conçu quatre prothèses pour un cochon, mais la douleur de Bert s'aggravant, il n'a pas droit à l'erreur.

programme.title: Le Magicien Des Protheses Animales
programme.desc: Ferdie est un bouc qui a été amputé de sa patte arrière à la suite à un accident. Ferdie essaie toujours de l'utiliser, ce qui est douloureux et encourage l'arthrite. Derrick doit fabriquer une prothèse pour Ferdie avant que sa situation n'empire.

programme.title: Le Magicien Des Protheses Animales
programme.desc: Elsa est une chienne qui a perdu ses quatre pattes à la suite d'une maladie transmise par les tiques, ce qui l'empêche de marcher. Derrick réalise rarement quatre prothèses pour un seul animal, mais le cas d'Elsa représente un défi intéressant.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Bruno essaie d'apprendre à jouer du trombone. // La cousine de Cléo, Lindsay, débarque en ville et Rif Raf est chargé de lui faire visiter.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Pop gets paroled from prison, but Heathcliff thinks he has escaped. // A lioness loses her baby when he accidentally falls from the circus caravan and lands in the junkyard.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Deux chats siamois spécialistes des arts martiaux débarquent en ville et saccagent tout sur leur passage. // Les Entrechats s'inscrivent à un concours de danse et Marcel est sélectionné pour la finale! La bande décide de l'entraîner.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: En lisant Playcat Magazine, Isidore se dit que la ville manque d'un club de luxe pour chats. // Lorsque César se retrouve en difficulté, Cléo menace Rif Raf de rompre si lui et sa bande n'accordent pas leur aide au chien.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Isidore remarque que Brutus et les chats errants ont disparu du quartier. // Cléo a été kidnappée! Les Entrechats construisent un appareil qui leur permettra de la retrouver saine et sauve.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Isidore est emmené dans un camp de discipline pour chats. // Marcel consulte son horoscope et découvre que les prédictions s'avèrent vraies. Hector échafaude un plan pour lui faire croire qu'il a des pouvoirs occultes.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Quand Marcie se fait insulter au club de tennis, Bruno lance un tournoi pour la défendre. // Marcel prépare une recette secrète héritée de sa maman et tout le monde l'adore!

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Heathcliff and Mungo meet the great cat-wrestler, Boom Boom Pussini. // At a beach party, Mungo falls for a pretty female feline who is just as taken with him.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Isidore suit les Michu dans leur voyage pour Marineland, où il a entendu parler d'une immense quantité de poisson. // Rif Raf est très jaloux de Pierre, un chef de cuisine qui sort avec Cléo.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Un terrible chat-robot s'impose comme le nouveau roi du catch dans la ville. // Lorsque Cléo s'intéresse à l'archéologie, les Entrechats décident de partir en expédition de leur côté.

programme.title: Les Entrechats
programme.desc: Heathcliff breaks into prison to save his father just as his father is released.

programme.title: Aux Armes!
programme.desc: Paul recherche une des plus incroyables armes de la Seconde Guerre mondiale: le légendaire fusil d'assaut FG-42.

programme.title: Aux Armes!
programme.desc: Reconstruction d'une batterie de mitrailleuse portable.

programme.title: Aux Armes!
programme.desc: Paul cherche un lance-flammes de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Chasseurs d’avions
programme.desc: L'obsession prend de nombreuses formes. Pour notre équipe, il s'agit de parcourir le monde entier pour trouver et récupérer des avions rares qui se sont écrasés pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, puis les restaurer pour qu'ils volent à nouveau.

programme.title: Sur la piste des dinosaures: Épisode 1 : Les mystères des dinosaures à corne
programme.desc: Dans le nord d'Alberta, des scientifiques tentent de comprendre ce qui a décimé d'un seul coup un troupeau entier de dinosaures. Dans le sud d'Alberta, une équipe de paléontologues cherche des fragments de crâne d'une nouvelle espèce de dinosaure à corne.

programme.title: Découvertes du monde
programme.desc: Vu d’avion, le Cambodge ressemble à un immense damier de rizières ponctuées de palmiers à sucre. Il possède aussi nombre de sites archéologiques remarquables comme Angkor et ses fameux temples.

programme.title: Découvertes du monde
programme.desc: La Guadeloupe est constituée de deux îles, Basse-Terre et Grande-Terre, séparées par un isthme étroit. Noyée entre l'émeraude et l'azur, entre l’Atlantique tropical et la mer des Caraïbes.

programme.title: Le tour du monde en 80 jours sans un sou: L’Inde : New Delhi - Varanasi
programme.desc: L’Inde est fascinante, à tel point que Milan et Muammer prennent le temps de jouer les touristes dans les ruelles de New-Delhi et devant le Taj Mahal à Agra.

programme.title: Le tour du monde en 80 jours sans un sou: La Thaïlande : Varanasi - Chumphon
programme.desc: Après un petit bain dans le Gange « pour se purifier », les « Optimistics Traveler » atteignent Calcutta, à l’Est de l’Inde. Leur nouvel objectif : se faire payer deux billets d’avion pour la Thaïlande.

programme.title: Le tour du monde en 80 jours sans un sou: La Malaisie : Chumphon - Singapour
programme.desc: Milan et Muammer sont arrivés en Thaïlande. Les avis divergent et la tension monte entre les deux aventuriers. La pluie les accompagne pour traverser la Malaisie puis Kuala Lumpur. Direction Singapour, c’est le bout du continent.

programme.title: Le tour du monde en 80 jours sans un sou: Les États-Unis : Singapour - San Francisco
programme.desc: Après quelques jours restés bloqués à Singapour, les « optimistic traveler » obtiennent leur graal, deux billets d’avions pour les Etats-Unis. Direction San Francisco, chez J.B. Woods qui les accueille chez lui dans la Silicon Valley.

programme.title: Le tour du monde en 80 jours sans un sou: Les États-Unis : Salt Lake City - New-York
programme.desc: Milan et Muammer ont entamé la traversée des Etats-Unis en train.

programme.title: Le tour du monde en 80 jours sans un sou: Le retour : New York - Paris
programme.desc: C’est la dernière ligne droite pour les « optimistic traveler » qui viennent de rejoindre New York. 73 jours et déjà trois continents traversés.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Nuit de l'Epouvantail
programme.desc: Lorsque Tante Tamsen, la tante (préférée) de Martin, achète une ferme pas trop loin de Torrington, Martin, Diana et Java arrivent en voiture pour le week-end afin de l'aider à cultiver et faire fonctionner la ferme. Au début, tout se passe bien...

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Les Prisonniers du Placard
programme.desc: M.O.M. envoie Martin, Diana et Java enquêter dans une université où une populaire joueuse de foot a mystérieusement disparue.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Le Réveil du Sorcier
programme.desc: Martin est un adolescent de 16 ans presque normal. En effet, quand il ne va pas au lycée il est agent spécial pour « Le Centre », une organisation secrète chargée de traquer les monstres et les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: L'Attaque de la Plante Carnivore
programme.desc: Martin, Diana et Java sont envoyés dans une ville voisine pour examiner les disparitions de plusieurs adolescents.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Malédiction du Pirate
programme.desc: Pendant que Martin et l'équipe sont en visite scolaire au Musée de la Marine, Martin s'éclipse du groupe (avec Java à sa suite). Il a hâte d'examiner les objets venant d'un vaisseau légendaire qui fût autrefois commandé par un pirate fantôme en maraude.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Bud, en pleine crise d’adolescence, adopte les comportements typiques de cet âge difficile : musique, langage et mauvaises manières.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Et voilà ! Encore des nouveaux locataires ! Nos amis n’en peuvent plus. Ces humains sont trop bêtes. Etno est persuadé qu’autrefois, moins nombreux sur terre, les humains devaient être moins gênants.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Depuis des jours et des nuits, Candy ne cesse de passer et repasser les disques de Snoutra, son chanteur de charme préféré. Les monstres sont à bout.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Dévorant du matin au soir une quantité impressionnante de gâteaux et bonbons en tous genres, Gorgious est atteint d’une véritable boulimie de sucreries.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Soignant avec amour ses amies les plantes, Candy prépare activement le Concours Annuel des Plantes et Jardins.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Privé de sa télévision tombée en panne au milieu de son western favori, Bud erre comme une âme en peine dans le grenier.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Les résultats de la loterie donnent le billet de Gorgious gagnant : 10 Millions de dollars!

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Epuisé par ses recherches et désespéré par le désordre endémique de son laboratoire, Etno se bricole un robot domestique pour exécuter toute la besogne à sa place.

programme.desc: Alors que la saison arrive à un tournant, une modification des quotas oblige les bateaux à repousser leurs limites, ce qui crée des tensions au sein de la flotte.

programme.title: Dora and Friends: Au Coeur de la Ville
programme.desc: Dora et ses amis aident la fermière Ana Maria à la ferme pédagogique. Les enfants adorent caresser les animaux mais ils doivent attendre leur tour très longtemps pour faire du cheval sur Doulcé, l'unique jument de la ferme.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: Dora et Babouche se mettent en route pour aider le Roi John à trouver sa couronne pour aller à sa fête d'anniversaire à Miami ! Où est-ce que le roi a-t-il posé sa couronne ?

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: La grand-mère de Dora offre à Babouche et Dora un cadeau pour leur nouveau chiot. Mais ils vont devoir se méfier de Chipeur qui a un tas de nouveaux tours dans son sac.

programme.title: Go Diego !
programme.desc: Diego aide Linda le lama à arriver à temps au carnaval.

programme.title: Go Diego !
programme.desc: Les animaux font la course dans la forêt tropicale. Diego fait équipe avec un tatou.

programme.title: Blaze et les Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze et ses amis participent à une course de nuit. L'expérience se complique lorsqu'une petite voleuse de lumières s'amuse à voler tous les projecteurs qui éclairent la piste.

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: Rod et Brody obtiendront leur badge d'exploration dans la jungle, à condition d'éviter les pièges et d'atteindre l'Arbre du Sommet. // Les élèves de Madame Oursousse font un stage d'une journée avec la Team Top Wing.

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: Shirley veut stocker sa récolte de gland mais elle se retrouve en danger. // Reggie veut faire de belles photos de la Team Top Wing pour un concours, mais Bandit veut sa part du gâteau.

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: La Team Top Wing passe au niveau deux de son entraînement et découvre ses nouveaux uniformes et véhicules. Mais avant la cérémonie, la team doit sauver la famille de Penny.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: Dora a une annonce importante à nous faire : sa famille accueille une nouvelle personne ! Quelqu'un qui dort dans un berceau, boit au biberon, porte des couches et adore être bercé pour s'endormir.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: Dora a oublié ses devoirs de musique dans la chambre de Babouche. Il doit alors lui apporter à l'école pour que Dora puisse entonner sa chanson en classe...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.desc: Après s'être disputé avec ses frères, Raphael va prendre l'air pour évacuer sa colère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Fungus Monstruosus
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja découvrent d'étranges champignons dans les égoûts de New York. Ce sont des champignons mutants, qui ont avalé du mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0
programme.desc: Donatello pense avoir réparé et amélioré Tête d'Acier, mais le robot continue d'avoir des bugs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Des rats et des hommes
programme.desc: Le Roi des Rats a créé un sérum de croissance au mutagène qu'il a injecté à ses rats. Ceux-ci enlèvent des humains, destinés à devenir une armée d'hommes-rats. Casey et Irma, une amie d'April, sont kidnappés et enfermés dans des cages dans les égoûts

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: iCarly: Le roi de la blague
programme.desc: Carly n'a jamais fait de blague et demande à Spencer de l'aider. Il fini par accepter, mais ses vieux démons le rattrapent. Lorsqu'il était en troisième, on l'appelait le roi de la blague, jusqu'au jour où.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam et sa mère
programme.desc: Freddie filme un vol au Groovy Smoothie, permettant d'identifier le criminel. Mais les journalistes révèlent le nom et l'adresse du jeune garçon en direct.

programme.title: iCarly: Pitié pour Nevel!
programme.desc: Nevel, l'ennemi numéro un de iCarly vient de se ridiculiser sur le net en criant sur une petite fille dans un supermarché... Désormais tout le monde le déteste, pour la plus grande joie de la bande d'iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Le stagiaire
programme.desc: L'émission a de plus en plus de succès et le groupe a donc de plus en plus de travail. Ils décident d'engager un stagiaire pour les aider.

programme.title: iCarly: lance la guerre des fans - Partie 1
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: iCarly: Révélation
programme.desc: Brad devient le nouveau stagiaire de l'émission. Freddie et lui créent une application pour Pear Pad : le testeur d'humeur. Freddie l'utilise sur Sam et découvre qu'elle est amoureuse.

programme.title: iCarly: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: iCarly: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.desc: Twister peut-il convaincre Otto et la bande que son concert de chant du Cinco de Mayo n'est pas totalement nul ? Le major Madison vient inspecter Ocean Shores et le lieutenant Ryan, maître-nageur, pense qu'il exigera une grande discipline.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Brise d'été / Le destin de Sammy
programme.desc: Les Rockets testent du matériel de sports nautiques. Lorsqu'il se casse, diront-ils à Breezy ce qu'ils pensent de son nouveau matériel ? Les Rocket rencontrent Patsy, une voyante, qui leur donne à tous des fortunes qui semblent se réaliser.

programme.title: Rocket Power: La partie de rugby / Bloqués par la neige
programme.desc: Trent décide d'enseigner le rugby aux Rocket, mais pense que ce sport pourrait être "trop dur" pour Reggie. Quand il se met à neiger, Otto et la bande s'amusent grâce à Sammy.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Marché conclu / Besoin d'air
programme.desc: Quand M. Stimpleton répare le vélo d'Otto, il lui doit une faveur. Quand l'asthme de Sam l'envoie à l'hôpital, les autres le traitent comme s'il allait retomber malade.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Reggie lance rocket / Fausse alerte
programme.desc: Reggie rencontre son idole, Missy "Le Missile" Giove, une coureuse de vélo de neige qui porte un piranha autour du cou pour lui porter chance. Quand Otto déclenche une alarme incendie et que Lars est accusé, Otto et Twister vont-ils avouer ?

programme.title: Rocket Power: Une plage pour deux / Toujours plus
programme.desc: Mme Rodriguez dit à Lars qu'il ne participera pas au championnat de hockey NHL s'il n'arrête pas d'intimider son frère. Les Rocket arrivent en finale du championnat de hockey NHL.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Le super mollusque / Un an de plus
programme.desc: Sam crée un jeu vidéo sur ses amis d'Ocean Shores. Otto fête ses 11 ans et décide qu'il est temps de commencer à se préparer à devenir un athlète professionnel.

programme.title: Rocket Power: Prince Waikikamukau 1/3

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: L'État d'Avatar
programme.desc: Aang et ses compagnons rencontrent un général du Royaume de la Terre. Celui-ci veut utiliser la puissance d'Aang en tant qu'Avatar pour combattre la Nation du Feu.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: La Grotte des amoureux
programme.desc: Sur la route d'Omashu, Aang et ses amis rencontrent des nomades qui les conduisent jusqu'à un tunnel appelé « la grotte des amoureux ». Ils se retrouvent perdus à l'intérieur et, pour en sortir, ils devront croire en l'amour.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: Retour à Omashu
programme.desc: Les enfants retournent à Omashu pour qu'Aang apprennent la maîtrise de la Terre avec le roi Bumi. Mais en arrivant, il découvre que la ville est aux mains de la Nation du Feu.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: Le marais
programme.desc: Quand les enfants arrivent dans un mystérieux marais, leurs peurs se réveillent. Aang en apprend sur les connections avec la Terre par un professeur inattendu.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: La fête de l'Avatar
programme.desc: Aang et ses amis découvrent une ville du Royaume de la Terre qui fête le jour de l'Avatar. Ils réalisent bien vite que les gens ne célèbrent pas mais sont en colère pour quelque chose qu'Aang a fait dans son passé.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: La fripouille aveugle
programme.desc: A la recherche d'un maître pour lui enseigner la maîtrise de la Terre, Aang et ses compagnons assistent à un tournoi de maîtres de la Terre. Il y reconnaît une jeune fille qu'il avait vue dans une des ses visions survenues dans le marais.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: Zuko, seul
programme.desc: Voyageant sans son oncle, Zuko erre seul dans le Royaume de la Terre et rencontre un jeune habitant local. Il est hanté par les souvenirs de son enfance.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: Pris en chasse
programme.desc: Pris en chasse par une machine mystérieuse, la fatigue des enfants les pousse à se disputer.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: Apprentissage difficile
programme.desc: Dans son apprentissage de l'élément Terre, Aang se demande si son professeur est celui qu'il lui faut.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: La Bibliothèque
programme.desc: Un professeur amène les enfants à une bibliothèque spirituelle. Sokka aimerait bien y dénicher des secrets pour lutter contre la Nation du Feu.

programme.title: Avatar, le dernier maître de l'air: Le désert
programme.desc: Aang recherche Appa tandis que Katara a du mal à faire en sorte que tout le monde reste ensemble dans le vaste désert. Pendant ce temps, Zuko et son oncle demandent de l'aide à une ancienne société secrète.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Une chaleur infernale
programme.desc: Une vague de chaleur touche Los Angeles et la bande décide d'aller à la plage dans la caravane de Beck. Mais une fois à l'intérieur, ils se retrouvent coincés... Et la température continue de grimper...

programme.title: Victorious FR: Connexion en Plein Ciel
programme.desc: Tori rentre en avion à Los Angeles. Celui-ci a beaucoup de retard et Tori doit faire d'urgence un devoir pour le lendemain matin. Elle décide alors de le faire via tchat avec André, Cat et Beck, depuis l'avion.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Freak the Freak Out, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Trina se fait enlever les dents de sagesse et Tori est chargée de s'occuper d'elle pendant que ses parents sont partis en weekend.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Freak the Freak Out, 2ème partie
programme.desc: Trina se fait enlever les dents de sagesse et Tori est chargée de s'occuper d'elle pendant que ses parents sont partis en weekend.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Tori Cascadeuse
programme.desc: Tori passe avec succès une audition mais n'obtient pas de rôle, elle est prise comme doublure cascade de la comédienne principale parce que dans son C.V. elle a menti en disant qu'elle avait fait de la gymnastique et du karaté.

programme.title: Victorious FR: La Nouvelle Directrice
programme.desc: Quand le directeur Eikner quitte Hollywood Arts, l'école engage une nouvelle directrice qui fait tous les élèves passer un oral de réadmission. Quels élèves seront renvoyés ?

programme.title: Victorious FR: Sous les Verrous - Première Partie
programme.desc: Festus propose à Tori d'aller avec ses amis à Yerba, son pays d'origine, passer des vacances gratuitement dans l'hôtel de son frère en échange d'un spectacle par soir.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Sous les Verrous - Deuxième Partie
programme.desc: Tori est en prison. Ses amis décident d'aller voir le chancelier pour lui demander de libéreré Tori. Après avoir hésité, il accepte mais au même moment Robbie fait tomber une lampe dans l'aquarium du chancelier et sa pieuvre adorée meurt.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Tori a le premier rôle
programme.desc: Tori et Jade se disputent le premier rôle dans "Steamboat Suzy". Tori remporte le rôle. Quand Robbie est admis aux Urgences, Tori rate presque la représentation pour lui donner son sang. Jade, sa doublure, aimerait beaucoup reprendre son rôle.

programme.title: Victorious FR: La Déprime de Sikowitz
programme.desc: Sikowitz reçoit une cafetière expresso de la part du directeur pour fêter ses dix années d'enseignement à Hollywood Arts. Tori trouve que ce n'est pas assez beau et l'invite à aller voir une pièce de théâtre avec ses amis.

programme.title: Victorious FR: Coup de foudre à Hollywood Arts
programme.desc: Andre tombe amoureux de Jade après avoir travaillé sur une chanson avec elle. Afin de l'aider à l'oublier, Tori se déguise en Jade et se comporte méchamment avec lui.

programme.title: The Masque of the Red Death (1964)

programme.title: The Pit and the Pendulum (1961)
programme.desc: Vincent Price slowly goes crazy because he thinks his wife was buried alive (a plot between his wife and her lover to get his money). Now totally insane, he starts to murder.

programme.title: The Quiet Man
programme.desc: An American ex-boxer returns to Ireland to win the hand of a spirited young woman. He is confronted by local customs and the woman's belligerent brother. Set in the verdant Irish countryside, this film has beautiful scenery and local charm.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee from government assassins after him. He races against the clock to discover the truth.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: A police officer (Mary J. Blige) investigating a fellow officer's murder discovers an evil spirit targeting the cops in her unit, uncovering a sinister secret surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth in this intense action thriller.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre 3D
programme.desc: A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick-ass heroes.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

programme.title: Lionheart
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme is Lyon Gaultier, a deserter in the French Foreign Legion who travels to the USA and enters the gory world of bare-knuckled street fighting in order to make money to save his brother's life and family.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Identical twins are separated at six months and raised on different continents. They reunite twenty-five years later to avenge the murder of their parents and reclaim their stolen family fortune.

programme.title: Who's Harry Crumb?
programme.desc: John Candy is bigger, better, and more bumbling than ever as a soft-headed private eye determined to crack a kidnapping case.

programme.title: Happy Gilmore
programme.desc: A bad-tempered hockey player takes his talent to the golf course to win a tournament prize and save his grandmother's house from the IRS.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: A trio of university parapsychologists lose their research grant and decide to open their own business, "Ghostbusters," and almost at once are summoned to investigate the strange happenings in a Central Park West apartment.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: New Year's Eve
programme.desc: Set in New York on New Year's Eve, this romantic comedy celebrates love, hope, forgiveness, second chances, and fresh starts through the intertwining stories of couples and singles, told amid the pulse and promise of the most dazzling night of the year.

programme.title: Predestination
programme.desc: For his final assignment, a top temporal agent must pursue the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time. The chase becomes a unique, surprising, and mind-bending exploration of love, fate, identity, and time-travel taboos.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

programme.title: Dear John
programme.desc: A soldier on home from leave meets and falls for the love of his life. As time and distance keep them apart, she falls in love with someone else and moves on.

programme.title: Burlesque
programme.desc: A small-town singer moves to the big city for her chance at stardom when she discovers Burlesque, a glamorous nightclub packed with dancers, sizzling musical numbers, and an owner in need of a star.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: In hopes of wooing a girl, Tristan promises to bring her a falling star. He soon discovers the star is actually a celestial beauty named Yvaine. When an old witch Lamia attempts to steal Yvaine's youth, Tristan must protect her.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programme.desc: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: It is Christmas Eve and the Harringtons take a trip to their in-laws to celebrate the holidays. Taking an unfamiliar shortcut, Mr. Harrington makes the biggest mistake of his life and leads his family down a terror-filled road with no end.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman

programme.title: Island In The Sky
programme.desc: Set after World War II, John Wayne plays Dooley, a former army pilot flying transport missions, who is forced to crash-land his fuel-starved plane on a frozen lake after it strays from its course.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee from government assassins after him. He races against the clock to discover the truth.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days
programme.desc: Almost a year has passed since vampires decimated Barrow, Alaska’s population. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been traveling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: The action and comedy never stop when Martin Lawrence and Will Smith reunite as out-of-control, trash-talking buddy cops. Bullets fly, cars crash, and laughs explode as they pursue a whacked-out drug lord from the streets of Miami to the barrios of Cuba.

programme.title: Set It Off
programme.desc: Jada Pinkett, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox and Kimberly Elise star as four African American women living in a Los Angeles housing project who--pushed to the edge--resort to violence to escape poverty.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Identical twins are separated at six months and raised on different continents. They reunite twenty-five years later to avenge the murder of their parents and reclaim their stolen family fortune.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnamese soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.

programme.title: Timecop
programme.desc: Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: A trio of university parapsychologists lose their research grant and decide to open their own business, "Ghostbusters," and almost at once are summoned to investigate the strange happenings in a Central Park West apartment.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Directed by Ivan Reitman. Starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis, Annie Potts. The Ghostbusters attempt to rid New York City of the slime and negative energy that plagues it.

programme.title: This Is Spinal Tap
programme.desc: Undoubtedly the funniest film ever made about rock and roll, Rob Reiner's satire about an over-the-hill heavy metal band is a priceless look at the music business and its madness.

programme.title: New Year's Eve
programme.desc: Set in New York on New Year's Eve, this romantic comedy celebrates love, hope, forgiveness, second chances, and fresh starts through the intertwining stories of couples and singles, told amid the pulse and promise of the most dazzling night of the year.

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally
programme.desc: As Harry Burns and Sally Albright build their lives and careers in Manhattan, their paths continue to cross, and their friendship continues to grow … until they confront the decision whether to let their friendship develop into romance.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: Burlesque
programme.desc: A small-town singer moves to the big city for her chance at stardom when she discovers Burlesque, a glamorous nightclub packed with dancers, sizzling musical numbers, and an owner in need of a star.

programme.title: A Star Is Born (2018)
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: Selena
programme.desc: Young. Beautiful. Enormously gifted. At 23, Selena shone as a fresh star in a vibrantly new musical field. But just as she was poised to be the next pop-music sensation, her life was tragically cut short.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: True Grit (1969)
programme.desc: The cantankerous Rooster is hired by a headstrong young girl (Kim Darby) to find the man who murdered her father and fled with the family savings.

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Afflicted with a terminal illness, John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Reunion
programme.desc: A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programme.desc: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: While She Was Out
programme.desc: Della (Academy-Award®-winner Kim Basinger), a suburban housewife, is hell-bent on survival as she is mercilessly stalked by a group of teenage thugs led by a manipulative psychopath (Luke Haas of WITNESS).

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: A single mother and her two sons discover much more than they anticipated in this visually stunning blend of hip humor, horror, and rock 'n' roll about the most compelling group of contemporary vampires ever to put fang to vein.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee
programme.desc: Michael J. Crocodile Dundee is a free-spirited Australian who hunts crocodiles with his bare hands, stares down giant water buffaloes, and drinks mere mortals under the table.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee II
programme.desc: Just as the eccentric Australian is starting to adjust to life in New York City, Dundee and his beautiful girlfriend (Linda Kozlowski) are targeted for death by a gang of ruthless drug dealers.

programme.title: GoodFellas
programme.desc: Director Martin Scorsese exposes the fascinating, mysterious, and violent underworld of New York's Mafia families through the life of insider Henry Hill.

programme.title: American Hustle
programme.desc: The con is on when scam artists and lovers Irving Rosenfeld and Sydney Prosser are entrapped by ambitious FBI agent Richie DiMaso and coerced into participating in a sting operation that hinges on snaring politician Carmine Polito and his associates.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Paul Schrader's gritty screenplay depicts the ever-deepening alienation of Vietnam Veteran Travis Bickle (Robert De Niro in a tour de force performance). This psychotic cab driver obsessively cruises the mean streets of Manhattan.

programme.title: Bringing Out the Dead
programme.desc: Frank Pierce, a paramedic, is on the brink of madness from too many years of saving and losing lives. One fateful night, Frank meets Mary Burke, the daughter of a man Frank tried to save. Together, Frank and Mary confront the ghosts of the past.

programme.title: First Reformed
programme.desc: The pastor (Ethan Hawke) of a small church in upstate New York spirals out of control after a soul-shaking encounter with an unstable environmental activist and his pregnant wife (Amanda Seyfried) in this taut, chilling thriller.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama, which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Chinatown
programme.desc: Jake Gittes, a private eye, uncovers a web of personal and political scandals while he is hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra marital affair.

programme.title: Godzilla (1998)
programme.desc: When the enormous monster descends upon New York, it's up to the Army and an odd team of investigators to unravel the mystery behind the incredible creature before it's too late.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)
programme.desc: Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.

programme.title: I Can Do Bad All by Myself
programme.desc: Madea catches teenage Jennifer and her two younger brothers looting her home. She decides to take matters into her own hands and delivers the young delinquents to the only relative they have, their aunt April, who wants nothing to do with the kids.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Meet the Browns
programme.desc: Soon after losing her job, a single mother takes her brood to Georgia for her father's funeral and meets his uproarious clan for the first time.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
programme.desc: Romantic sparks fly between a wealthy businessman and a struggling single mother who works as a cleaner in his office building.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
programme.desc: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

programme.title: Troy

programme.title: Down in the Delta

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations

programme.title: Star Trek VIII: First Contact

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection

programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day have finally moved into their own apartment, but a ghetto grinch breaks in and steals all their Christmas presents—and the rent money. To avoid eviction before Christmas, the cousins take jobs as unarmed security guards at a strip mall.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee from government assassins after him. He races against the clock to discover the truth.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Rosario
programme.desc: Trapped by a snowstorm with her estranged grandmother's corpse, Rosario (Emeraude Toubia) faces terrifying supernatural forces and a deadly family curse.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: A remake of George Mihalka's 1981 classic slasher film, MY BLOODY VALENTINE takes place ten years after a devastating coal mining accident when a string of gruesome murders plagues a town.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre 3D
programme.desc: A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

programme.title: Set It Off
programme.desc: Jada Pinkett, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox and Kimberly Elise star as four African American women living in a Los Angeles housing project who--pushed to the edge--resort to violence to escape poverty.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

programme.title: Knock Off
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme plays a fashion designer who must join forces with a C.I.A. agent to combat terrorism.

programme.title: Legionnaire
programme.desc: Alain is a boxer in 1925 Marseille, France. When he doesn't take the dive paid to take by a mob boss, he has to split. He joins the Foreign Legion and is sent to Morocco. He makes 3 friends and they watch each other's backs.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: The Return
programme.desc: The "Universal Soldiers" must fight the entire army when the military's supercomputer, S.E.T.H., gets out of control.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun. Co-starring Phil Hartman and Jon Lovitz, the '¡Three Amigos!' blaze a side-splitting trail across the comedy frontier!

programme.title: I'll Be Homeless for Christmas
programme.desc: When a petty thief learns that his latest mark is a struggling single mother who works at a homeless shelter, he decides to use his savvy street smarts to make this Christmas one to remember for her and her young son.

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Multiple Academy Award winner Tom Hanks reunites with his Sleepless in Seattle co-star, Meg Ryan, and director Nora Ephron, to discover love at first byte in this online romantic comedy.

programme.title: Dear John
programme.desc: A soldier on home from leave meets and falls for the love of his life. As time and distance keep them apart, she falls in love with someone else and moves on.

programme.title: The Family Stone
programme.desc: A comic story about the annual holiday gathering of a New England family, the Stones.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Selena
programme.desc: Young. Beautiful. Enormously gifted. At 23, Selena shone as a fresh star in a vibrantly new musical field. But just as she was poised to be the next pop-music sensation, her life was tragically cut short.

programme.title: The Bling Ring
programme.desc: A teenager and his gang of fame-obsessed youths use the Internet to track the whereabouts of celebrities, then rob their homes.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights, and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose offhand arrogance triggers a tragedy that ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: It is Christmas Eve and the Harringtons take a trip to their in-laws to celebrate the holidays. Taking an unfamiliar shortcut, Mr. Harrington makes the biggest mistake of his life and leads his family down a terror-filled road with no end.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.

programme.title: The Innkeepers
programme.desc: After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees - Claire and Luke - are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels.

programme.title: Poltergeist
programme.desc: At first, the spirits that invade the Freelings' home seem like playful children. But then they turn angry. And when 10-year-old Carol Anne is pulled from this world into another, Steve and Diane Freeling turn to an exorcist.

programme.title: Poltergeist III
programme.desc: In the climactic finale to the Poltergeist trilogy, those elusive demons are more frightening than ever as they follow Carol Anne to Chicago and inhabit an entire skyscraper.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Crocodile Dundee returns in this hilarious third installment of the beloved film series. After Mick's girlfriend, Sue, is assigned to the L.A. bureau of her father's newspaper, Mick, Sue, and their son Mikey head to Hollywood.

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: Leslie Nielsen stars as Police Squad's own granite-jawed, rockbrained cop Frank Drebin, who bumbles across a mind control scheme to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: American Hustle
programme.desc: The con is on when scam artists and lovers Irving Rosenfeld and Sydney Prosser are entrapped by ambitious FBI agent Richie DiMaso and coerced into participating in a sting operation that hinges on snaring politician Carmine Polito and his associates.

programme.title: Rolling Thunder
programme.desc: William Devane and Tommy Lee Jones star as two former P.O.W.s out for revenge in this neo-noir action-thriller that Quentin Tarantino cites as one of his favorite films. Written by genre masters Paul Schrader and Heywood Gould. John Flynn directs.

programme.title: American Gigolo (1980)
programme.desc: Julian Kay has it all: the Mercedes, the clothes, access to Beverly Hills' swankiest establishments, and a stable of rich, female clients. But it all falls apart after he does a favor for his former pimp and the trick turns up dead a short while later.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama, which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: Chinatown
programme.desc: Jake Gittes, a private eye, uncovers a web of personal and political scandals while he is hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra marital affair.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: The Fifth Element
programme.desc: Bruce Willis, Milla Jovovich, and Gary Oldman star in acclaimed director Luc Besson's outrageous sci-fi adventure, an extravagantly styled tale of good against evil set in an unbelievable twenty-third-century world.

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)
programme.desc: Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.

programme.title: When a Stranger Calls (2006)
programme.desc: To Jill Johnson, it was the perfect babysitting job. The parents were away. The fridge was stocked. The children were tucked into bed. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: The Single Moms Club
programme.desc: Brought together by their children's potential expulsion from school, diverse single mothers (Nia Long, Amy Smart, Cocoa Brown) form a support group to help one another overcome life's challenges.

programme.title: I Can Do Bad All by Myself
programme.desc: Madea catches teenage Jennifer and her two younger brothers looting her home. She decides to take matters into her own hands and delivers the young delinquents to the only relative they have, their aunt April, who wants nothing to do with the kids.

programme.title: Rambo
programme.desc: John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) calls upon his long-buried but lethal skills to rescue a missionary (Julie Benz) and her comrades from the Burmese army.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Throughout time, men have waged war. Some for power, some for glory, some for honor ... and some for love.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.

programme.title: Beyond The Lights
programme.desc: The pressures of fame have superstar singer Noni on the edge until she meets Kaz, a young cop who works to help her find the courage to develop her own voice and break free to become the artist she was meant to be.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
programme.desc: Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: The greatest adventure of all time begins with Star Trek, the incredible story of a young crew's maiden voyage onboard the most advanced starship ever created: the U.S.S. Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: When a ruthless mastermind, Khan (Benedict Cumberbatch), declares a one-man war on the Federation, Captain Kirk (Chris Pine), Spock (Zachary Quinto), and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise set out on their most explosive manhunt of all time.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
programme.desc: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Fear of a Black Hat
programme.desc: A mockumentary chronicling the rise and fall of NWH, a not particularly talented--or particularly bright but always controversial--hip-hop group.

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: Set in Paris, Rush Hour 3 finds Chris Tucker and Jackie Chan's misfit partners from West and East battling a wing of the Chinese organized crime family of the Triads -- with their trademark mix of great action and big laughs.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Assassin Club
programme.desc: Henry Golding, Sam Neill, and Noomi Rapace star in this action-packed thriller. An elite assassin is given his final contract to kill six people around the world - only to discover the targets are equally skilled assassins hired to kill him.

programme.title: House of Gucci
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.

programme.title: MST3K: First Spaceship On Venus
programme.desc: A multinational team of astronauts heads to Venus, but finds a world destroyed by nuclear war.

programme.title: MST3K Shorts

programme.desc: Michel Aubry, virtuoso del pianoforte, è trovato morto vicino a una foresta parigina, investito da un'auto dopo una corsa nel bosco.

programme.title: Alice Nevers
programme.desc: Nel convento delle Appoline, Alice e Marquand indagano sull’omicidio di Suor Benedetta, avvelenata tra le braccia di Corinne Leblanc.

programme.title: Alice Nevers
programme.desc: Matteo Fabrizzi, giovane stilista tirannico, viene trovato morto nel suo atelier: forzato a mangiare fino a far esplodere lo stomaco.

programme.title: Streghe
programme.desc: Un demone trasforma le persone nella personificazione di ogni peccato mortale, incluse le Streghe del Trio e Leo.

programme.title: Streghe
programme.desc: Cole si finge Belthazar per infiltrarsi in una confraternita gestita da demoni, che trama di controllare il flusso di informazioni di tutto il mondo su Internet.

programme.title: Streghe
programme.desc: La Confraternita trama di sabotare la relazione di Cole con Phoebe nel tentativo di farlo tornare malvagio. Intanto, il potere di Piper si sviluppa con risultati esplosivi.

programme.title: Streghe
programme.desc: Phoebe ha una visione di un demone Banshee assassino, mentre consulta la sezione su Belthazar del Libro delle Ombre, facendole credere che Cole sia il responsabile.

programme.title: Streghe
programme.desc: Quando le sorelle Halliwell vengono smascherate come streghe in diretta nazionale, stringono un patto con la Sorgente per tornare indietro nel tempo e rimediare al danno. Nel mentre, una delle sorelle compie l'estremo sacrificio.

programme.title: Streghe
programme.desc: Prue e Piper Halliwell si trasferiscono nella villa vittoriana della nonna sulle colline di San Francisco. Quando la sorella minore e pecora nera, Phoebe, va a vivere con loro, scoprono di essere le discendenti di un'antica profezia Wicca.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Sydney e Nigel cercano la pistola di Al Capone, tempestata di diamanti.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Quando l'aereo di Sydney precipita, un gruppo di suore le chiede di trovare la testa di un'altra suora.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Sydney e Nigel si recano a Lavaree, California, sulle tracce della prima bandiera dello stato.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Sydney e Nigel vanno in Germania a cercare una chitarra di Elvis Presley andata perduta.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel e il rivale cacciatore di reliquie Kurt Reiner si mettono alla ricerca del guanto da baseball.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Proust rischia il posto. Nina convince Smireni a riaprire l’ambulatorio del dolore. Un ragazzo cieco riacquista la vista ma fatica ad accettarlo. Léo ritrova Maud mentre in reparto nascono nuove alleanze.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina inaugura l’ambulatorio del dolore e si avvicina a Smireni. Proust cura un uomo in crisi e aiuta una famiglia a ricomporsi. Léo vive un nuovo amore, ma l’equilibrio resta fragile.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Una coppia tenta il suicidio dopo il fallimento del ristorante. Kevin e Aurélia affrontano un paziente che inventa ricordi. Nina scopre un segreto sull’eredità del padre: Smireni potrebbe essere suo fratello.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina aiuta una turista giapponese delusa dall’amore. Léo segue un detenuto che vuole riconciliarsi con la figlia. Smireni teme una ricaduta per Steve. Nina e Marc si avvicinano sempre più.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Marina, ex compagna di stanza di Lily, rifiuta le cure nonostante una possibile recidiva. Proust affronta il passato con una paziente che dice di essere sua madre. Nina rivela la verità a Gloria.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Durante l'inseguimento di un rapinatore, Giulia spara e ferisce gravemente un bambino. Mentre il distretto dà la caccia al criminale, il commissario affronta una dolorosa crisi di coscienza.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Le conseguenze del tragico incidente che ha coinvolto il bambino continuano a pesare su Giulia Corsi, sottoposta a un'inchiesta sul proprio operato. Il X Tuscolano viene impegnato in un delicato caso di sequestro: una ragazza cardiopatica viene rapita.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Un'auto pirata investe un bambino, amico dell'ispettore Belli. Un "latin lover" denuncia che i suoi incontri amorosi sono on line. L'appartamento dell'orafo Leone è disabitato; si scopre che l'uomo è in cura dagli Alcolisti Anonimi.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Dopo aver denunciato un estorsore che gli chiede il pizzo, un concessionario subisce il rapimento della figlia. Il distretto si mobilita per salvarla, mentre Giulia scopre che Roberto frequenta la dottoressa Francesca Volta.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Roberto indaga su una banda che utilizza l'ipnosi per derubare le proprie vittime. Intanto Ingargiola riceve una notizia inattesa e Parmesan scopre un collegamento tra Carla Monti e l'orafo Leone.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Una donna, da poco divorziata e madre di una bambina di due anni, viene trovata morta nella tenuta di famiglia appena ereditata. Un delitto che riapre ferite intime e legali.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Louise, 16 anni, viene trovata morta nel cassonetto del locale del padre. Alain Louvion, uomo ruvido e fuori dagli schemi, avverte il giudice Filiponi: se trova l’assassino prima della polizia, lo ucciderà.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Ingrid Montauban, 30 anni, splendida agente immobiliare di lusso, viene trovata morta nella piscina di una villa esclusiva che stava per vendere. Un delitto che scuote il mondo dorato dell’alta società.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Margot, 17 anni, promessa del nuoto francese, viene violentata negli spogliatoi del suo club poche settimane prima delle selezioni olimpiche. Con lei c’era solo il suo allenatore, David Grimm.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Victor Jacquet, 68 anni, potente direttore di una fabbrica tessile, viene assassinato. Il giudice Filiponi e la stagista Constance Meyer indagano su un uomo autoritario, pronto a cedere l’azienda al figlio.

programme.desc: Forgiatura della grande spada a due mani Wylder da Elden Ring Nightreign. Il video mostra ogni fase: lama, guardia, manico e pomolo, fino al montaggio finale e ai test di taglio.

programme.desc: Primo episodio dedicato alla forgiatura di una spada vichinga con lama damascata a forma di serpente, nucleo in acciaio 1040 e bordi taglienti in damasco intrecciato, seguita da trattamento termico.

programme.title: Black Beard Projects
programme.desc: Costruzione di una fucina a gas propano per la lavorazione del ferro. La struttura usa lana ceramica, refrattario ad alta allumina e mattoni refrattari. Incluso test finale con bruciatori venturi.

programme.title: Black Beard Projects
programme.desc: Realizzazione di un pugnale quillon da rottami metallici: dalla forgiatura alla molatura, trattamento termico, finitura della lama e fusione della guardia.

programme.desc: Una giovane diabetica affronta una delusione d'amore quando scopre di essere rimasta incinta dopo una relazione clandestina.

programme.desc: Trixie e Suor Mary Cynthia collaborano per assistere una futura mamma audiolesa, mentre un caso di nausea mattutina si rivela più grave del previsto.
